diagnose.pending: No router has answered for the Route yet.
diagnose.notAdmitted: No router has admitted the Route: no router runs, or no router's shard selects it.
diagnose.notAdmittedWhy: A router serves only the Routes its route and namespace selectors pick (the IngressController's routeSelector and namespaceSelector).
diagnose.noHost: The Route has no host yet.
diagnose.tlsNone: No TLS: the Route serves plain HTTP.
diagnose.insecureRedirect: Plain HTTP is redirected to HTTPS.
diagnose.insecureAllow: Plain HTTP is served as well.
diagnose.tlsPassthrough: TLS is passed through to the pods unopened: the pods hold the certificate.
diagnose.tlsExternal: The certificate comes from Secret {{name}}; Sextant does not read it here.
diagnose.tlsRouterCertificate: The Route sets no certificate: the router's default certificate is served.
diagnose.tlsNoKey: The Route sets a certificate but no private key.
diagnose.tlsServiceCa: No destination CA certificate: the router trusts the service CA for the connection to the pods.
diagnose.tlsEdge: TLS ends at the router; it sends plain HTTP to the pods.
diagnose.tlsReencrypt: TLS ends at the router, which opens a new TLS connection to the pods.
diagnose.tlsUnknown: The TLS termination {{termination}} is not one OpenShift knows.
diagnose.notService: The backend is {{kind}} {{name}}, not a Service: the router sends nothing to it.
diagnose.allWeightsZero: Every backend's weight is 0: the router answers 503.
diagnose.weightZero: Service {{name}} has weight 0: it gets no requests.
diagnose.serviceMissing: Service {{name}} does not exist in namespace {{namespace}}: the router answers 503. A Route sends only to Services of its own namespace.
diagnose.namedTargetUnknown: Target port {{port}} may be the pod port a named target port of Service {{name}} leads to; Sextant cannot tell which.
diagnose.noNamedPort: Service {{name}} has no port named {{port}} (its ports: {{ports}}): the router has no endpoint to send to.
diagnose.noTargetPort: No port of Service {{name}} targets pod port {{port}} (its ports: {{ports}}): the router has no endpoint to send to.
diagnose.everyPort: Without a target port the router sends to every port of the Service ({{ports}}); the checks below follow the first.
diagnose.service: The Route sends to Service {{name}}, port {{port}}.
